rows: - Benchmark of the slice (same harness, n=5, `rca-rust-slice2.json`): cold start 31.9 ms (Node 503.4), idle RSS 4.0 MB (133.6), diff register and page 9.5 ms p50 at 9.5 MB resident (39.5 ms; Node was at 326.8 MB by then, with every earlier scenario loaded), markdown preview 1.04 ms (1.2), TypeScript preview 0.70 ms (1.2); the whole process peaks at 9.9 MB. Artifact 14,269,840 bytes (462,080 before this slice): the grammars and `fancy-regex` are the growth, so the binary is now about the size of the Node bundle (14,869,215 bytes) though it needs no `node_modules` (about 245 MB of media packages alone); trimming the rarely used grammars is a later size decision, not made here.
